reason: I'd normally bounce off a store I've never heard of, but 60 verified reviews with real install photos, the same reviews on Google, a UL number I can look up, and free 30-day returns take most of the risk out. I'd still Google the store name first, and if that comes up clean I'd order one pendant.
objection: I've never heard of this store. Sixty reviews is a small number, there's no Trustpilot page, and it's one person in Oklahoma, so I worry about what happens if the light arrives damaged or the founder is out sick.
would_change_my_mind: Finding a bad pattern in the Google reviews or Trustpilot (unanswered complaints, refund fights), or the UL listing number not checking out. A Trustpilot page with a decent score would make me more comfortable.
